method.name: QUERY
rules: A query dialect URL (/q/, /q/video, /q/<endpoint>) is sent as QUERY to its path without the query, with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded and the URL's query string, exactly as the builder wrote it (xi_sig included), as the content.
The signature is the GET URL's: xi_sig signs the path after the mount and the query, not the method, so the content of a signed QUERY is the query of a signed GET URL and the other way round.

application/json content is an object of the same parameters in order (strings, numbers as written, true/false, arrays joined with ","; null skipped); its canonical query, which xi_sig signs, escapes keys and values like url.query_safe and joins them with &.

A 2xx response may carry Location (the equivalent GET URL) and Accept-Query; 405 means the server or the endpoint does not accept QUERY (XI_SERVER_QUERY_METHOD), 413 content too large, 415 unsupported media type.

rules.imgproxy: path = "/" + options + "/" + source; URL = base + "/" + sig(path) + path.
rules.info: path as imgproxy; URL = base + "/info/" + sig(path) + path (the signature does not cover "/info").
rules.mac: sig(msg) = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(key, salt ‖ msg)[:size]); key and salt are hex (XI_SIGNING_KEYS, XI_SIGNING_SALTS) or raw bytes; a msg without a leading "/" is signed as "/" + msg.
rules.query_method: an HTTP QUERY request signs as its equivalent GET URL: msg = path after the mount + "?" + the content's canonical query without xi_sig (form content as written; JSON content per query.method.rules); xi_sig is a parameter of the content.
rules.unsigned: without a key the signature segment is a placeholder (default "insecure") and the query dialect has no xi_sig.
rules.video: path as imgproxy; URL = base + "/video/" + sig("/video" + path) + path: the signature covers "/video" + path, so no image signature is valid for a /video URL.
rules.xi_sig: msg = path after the mount ("/", "/video", "/resize") + "?" + the query's non-empty parameters except xi_sig, in order and as written (no "?" when none remain); the URL ends in "&xi_sig=" + sig(msg). Re-signing drops any earlier xi_sig; two xi_sig parameters are an error.

rules: The key is the first of XI_ENCRYPTION_KEYS, hex or raw bytes (16, 24 or 32 bytes).
The IV is 16 random bytes per token; a fixed IV (deterministic mode) is allowed for tests and cache keys.
An encrypted source is "enc/" + token, split like base64 sources, with "." + extension after it.
A plaintext must be non-empty and free of ASCII control characters (C0 and DEL).

pdf_password: the token over the UTF-8 password (at most max_pdf_password_bytes) is the first option segment, written verbatim (a separator inside it is joined back by the server); in the query dialect it is the pdp (or pdf_password) key after the other keys. It needs both an encryption key and signing: the server refuses it on unsigned URLs. /video URLs take none.
An option segment is name + sep + args joined by sep; an option needs at least one argument.

Arguments: booleans are 1/0, null and absent are empty, numbers use the shortest round-trip decimal (ECMAScript Number::toString: 300, 1.5, 0.1, 1e+21), strings are written verbatim and must not contain "/", the separator, "?", "#", whitespace or control characters.
Option names: "short" writes each option's short name (default), "canonical" its name, "given" the name as the caller wrote it (a name or an alias). Unknown names are an error.
Options objects are written in insertion order; a list of objects chains pipelines with "/-/"; empty pipelines are dropped. /info and /video URLs have one pipeline.

Sources: base64 (default) is base64url_nopad(utf8(source)) + "." + ext; plain is "plain/" + the source percent-encoded except letters, digits and plain_safe (UTF-8, upper-case hex) + "@" + ext; encrypted is "enc/" + token + "." + ext. split_source N splits base64 and encrypted tokens into "/"-joined chunks of N characters.
A source is non-empty and has no ASCII control characters. Extensions match extension_pattern.
The base URL loses trailing slashes; without one, URLs are root-relative.

Query dialect: keys and values are percent-encoded except letters, digits and query_safe; native values: booleans true/false, numbers as above; null/absent keys are skipped; order: url, native keys, o, format, pdp, xi_sig.
/q/video: every /video option is a key (short, canonical or given name; crop and flip as native_video_keys) whose arguments are joined by "," and may not contain ":"; then format.

Streams: a /video URL with the protocol's manifest container as extension; renditions add stream:<protocol>:<h>…, segment_duration adds sgd, a non-default segment format adds sgf (ts is HLS only); stream, segment_duration, segment_format and format may not also be given as options.
Imaginary: /q/<endpoint>?url=…&<param>=…; endpoint matches ^[a-z]+$ and is not "video".

kind.description: Error kind (errs.Kind), one per row of the status table. See the status table in the ErrorResponse description.

message.description: Client-safe message; internal error text is never sent.

request_id.description: Request ID, also in the logs.

ErrorResponse.description:
JSON error body, sent when Accept lists application/json (text/plain otherwise). Status per kind (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12; XI_COMPAT_IMGPROXY_STATUS=true answers 400 and forbidden 403 with 404, like imgproxy):

| kind | status | message |
|---|---|---|
| unknown | 500 | internal server error |
| invalid_url | 400 | invalid url |
| unauthorized | 403 | invalid signature |
| forbidden | 403 | forbidden |
| expired | 404 | url expired |
| not_found | 404 | source image not found |
| source_too_large | 422 | source image too large |
| limit_exceeded | 422 | image exceeds processing limits |
| unsupported | 422 | unsupported image format |
| corrupt | 422 | image cannot be decoded |
| hash_mismatch | 422 | source hash mismatch |
| not_acceptable | 406 | no acceptable image format |
| upstream_error | 502 | upstream error |
| upstream_timeout | 504 | upstream timeout |
| overloaded | 429 | too many requests |
| unavailable | 503 | service unavailable |
| timeout | 504 | processing timeout |
| canceled | 499 | request canceled |
| internal | 500 | internal server error |

499 (canceled) is logged, never written.

class_id.description: Class index in the classifier's output (the ImageNet-1k class id by default).

name.description: Class name (ImageNet-1k: tabby cat, golden retriever, pizza, ...).

content.description: What the image is to the document: composite (full-size flattened image), thumbnail (reduced copy), preview (first page), document (SVGZ: the whole document, decompressed), frame (MNG: the first image of the animation) or converted (WMF, EMF: the document converted to SVG).

entry.description: Where the image was found: the path inside the archive (mergedimage.png, QuickLook/Thumbnail.png, previews/preview.png, ...), gzip for SVGZ, header thumbnail for Paint.NET, first frame for MNG, JDAT (JDAT+IDAT, JDAT+JDAA with alpha) for JNG, xi-metafile2svg for WMF and EMF.

format.description: Container format: ora (OpenRaster), kra (Krita), procreate, sketch, svgz, pdn (Paint.NET), mng, jng, wmf or emf.

mime_type.description: Media type of the container, e.g. image/openraster.

class_id.description: 0 for faces (the face model's only class), the COCO class index for objects.

class_name.description: face, or a COCO class name (person, car, dog, traffic light, ...).

height.description: Box height, as a fraction of the image height.

landmarks.description: Face landmarks [x, y] as fractions of the image: right eye, left eye, nose tip, right and left mouth corners (faces only; an extension over imgproxy).

left.description: Left edge of the box, as a fraction of the oriented image width.

top.description: Top edge of the box, as a fraction of the oriented image height.

width.description: Box width, as a fraction of the image width.

InfoResponse.description: imgproxy-compatible /info body (docs/URL-DIALECTS.md §3.3). Each section is present exactly when its info option is on; a requested exif, iptc or xmp section is {} when the source has none.

alpha.description: Whether the source has an alpha channel (info option alpha).

bands.description: Number of bands (channels), alpha included (info option bands).

classification.description: The top_k classes of the image classifier (ImageNet-1k by default), best first; absent when no classifier is available (the option is then listed in X-Xi-Ignored) (info option classify).

colorspace.description: libvips interpretation name: srgb, b-w, rgb16, cmyk, ... (info option colorspace).

container.description: xtandard-image extension (info option format): the source is a designer document (OpenRaster, Krita, Procreate, Sketch, SVGZ, Paint.NET) and format, dimensions and the other fields describe the image embedded in it; absent otherwise.

crop.description: Crop rectangle as fractions of the oriented image (info option crop).

dominant_colors.description: Dominant RGB colours by class; missing classes are left out unless built (info option dominant_colors).

exif.description: EXIF tags keyed by libexif title, with libexif's human-readable values; {} when the source has none (info option exif).

format.description: Source format in imgproxy's names: jpeg (UltraHDR too), png, webp, avif, heic, jxl, gif, tiff, bmp, ico, svg, pdf, psd, ... (info option format).

gain_map.description: xtandard-image extension: true when the source carries an HDR gain map (UltraHDR JPEG, ISO 21496-1 JPEG, AVIF or HEIC tmap item); its pixels are the SDR base, and preserve_hdr or gain_map:hdr render the HDR version for AVIF, JPEG XL and JPEG outputs; absent otherwise.

hashsums.description: Hex digests of the source bytes by algorithm: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512 (info option calc_hashsums).

hdr.description: xtandard-image extension: true for scene-linear sources (OpenEXR, Radiance, PFM), which imgproxy does not read, and for sources with an HDR gain map; absent otherwise.

height.description: Height of one page or frame in pixels, EXIF orientation applied (info option dimensions).

iptc.description: IPTC IIM datasets keyed by title, repeatable datasets as arrays; {} when the source has none (info option iptc).

mime_type.description: Source media type, e.g. image/jpeg; HEIC is image/heif (info option format).

objects.description: Detected faces and objects, best first within each model (faces first), with boxes as fractions of the oriented image; [] when none were found (info option detect_objects).

orientation.description: EXIF orientation 1-8, 1 when absent (info option dimensions).

pages_number.description: Number of pages, or frames of an animation (info option pages_number).

palette.description: Up to the requested number of RGBA colours (info option palette).

perceptual_hash.description: Perceptual hash as 16 lower-case hex digits (info option phash).

photoshop.description: Photoshop image resources, e.g. resolution, when present (info option iptc).

sample_format.description: libvips band format name: uchar, ushort, float, ... (info option sample_format).

size.description: Source size in bytes (info option size).

thumb_hash.description: ThumbHash as upper-case hex (info option thumbhash).

video_meta.description: Container metadata of a video source (info option video_meta): the container tags as strings (major_brand, creation_time, encoder, ...), like imgproxy, plus container (mov, matroska, avi), codec, duration (s), fps, bit_rate (bit/s), frames, width and height (coded size) and rotation (clockwise degrees) of the video stream thumbnails are taken from.

video_streams.description: Every stream of a video source in file order (info option video_meta), in imgproxy's shape.

width.description: Width of one page or frame in pixels, EXIF orientation applied (info option dimensions).

xmp.description: XMP properties grouped by namespace prefix; {} when the source has none (info option xmp).

bps.description: Bit rate in bits per second, when known.

channels.description: xtandard-image extension: channel count of an audio stream.

codec.description: FFmpeg codec name: h264, hevc, vp9, av1, aac, ...

fps.description: Average frame rate of a video stream.

frequency.description: Sample rate of an audio stream in Hz.

height.description: xtandard-image extension: coded height of a video stream.

layout.description: Channel layout of an audio stream: mono, stereo, 5.1(side), ...

rotation.description: xtandard-image extension: clockwise display rotation of a video stream (0, 90, 180, 270).

type.description: video, audio, subtitle, data or attachment.

width.description: xtandard-image extension: coded width of a video stream.
